title: Outer action of representation category of discrete quantum groups: a case study
summary: Given any tracial von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{A}$, the first author has defined a unitary tensor functor $Φ:{\rm Rep}(\mathcal{Q}_{\rm aut}(\mathcal{A}))\to {\rm Bimod}(\mathcal{A})$ in his paper [Gos24]. In this paper, we consider $\mathcal{A}$ to be the underlying von Neumann algebra of $C^*(S_3)$ and show that given any DQG $\mathcal{Q}$, which contains $C^*(S_3)$ as a quantum subgroup and has an outer action $\tildeΦ$ (in the sense of Definition 3.4}) on ${\rm Bimod}(\mathcal{A})$, which agrees with $Φ$ when restricted on ${\rm Rep}(C^*(S_3))$, is monoidally equivalent to the DQG…
